thread:
Alex: rolling out v1 of kernel-selector telemetry and token-accounting now. Need a quick review of dashboard panels before we flip defaults.
Maria: high level?
Alex: emitting per-token tags for sampled traces: kernel_id, sel_ver, batch, seq_len, kv_hit, token_billed(true/false), kernel_ns. Full traces -> clickhouse (1% sampling default). Aggregates -> prometheus histograms + counters.
Sam: arrays per-token are huge. sample 1% + aggregate histograms; for large routes 5-10%.
Jordan: dashboard reqs: token latency split (kv_lookup | kernel_exec | decode | postproc), billed_tokens vs total_tokens, cost_per_billed_token, tokens_per_request distribution, kv_hit_rate.
Maria: billing alignment: need to ensure tokens we mark billed map 1:1 with usage API. If kv_hit -> not billed.
Alex: Implementation note: at serve-time we mark token_billed=false when emitted from KV prefix reuse. Also emit kv_evicted_count per request.
Sam: Cost mapping: telemetry will emit kernel_gpu_ns counter + kernel_tokens counter. Offline job maps gpu_ns to $ using region price table. Example calc:
```
kernel_gpu_ns = 1.2e9
kernel_tokens = 4e4
avg_token_ns = kernel_gpu_ns / kernel_tokens = 3e4 ns
gpu_price_hour = $2.4
$/ns = 2.4 / 3600 / 1e9 = 6.667e-10
cost_per_token = avg_token_ns * $/ns = 3e4 * 6.667e-10 = $2e-5
```
Jordan: alerts: p95 latency > baseline*1.20, cost_per_billed_token > baseline*1.15, kv_hit_rate drop >5%. Also regression detection on selector versions.
Alex: discovered perf regression: quantized matmul kernel qmatmul_v3 shows ~15% p99 regressions for batch==1 and seq_len>2048. Selector currently prefers qmatmul_v3 for cost. Added guard: if (decoder && batch==1 && seq_len>1024) prefer fmatmul_v1 fallback.
Maria: can we retro-tag historic requests by selector_v to compare? we need selector_v emitted as header for a rollback window.
Alex: yes, selector_v tag will be in traces (selector_v=20251110a). Dashboards split by selector_v and kernel_id. Also adding label commit_sha.
Sam: sampling strategy: default 1%, route overrides for heavy cost routes (5-10%), anomaly-triggered full traces for 10 minutes when alerts fire.
Jordan: final: I'll make panels and share a link. We should also add a lightweight export to billing team so cost_per_token is included in invoice reconciliation.
